'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Walseth LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Walseth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Incomplete player name as written. Sheet title I never have time to make new Light Sides. Start line partially illegible (They're… / We'll Handle…); MWYHL used from Tatooine junkyard / remote planet package.
